_comment: regression-1's expectations — a GUARD row. See core-1.json for the full contract.
A guard row is one the incumbent already passes, so it cannot show improvement, only
regression. That is a role, not a defect: it is the only thing that catches a body edit
silently breaking what used to work. Keep the four-check floor anyway — a guard scored by
one check is a guard that can only say `broken` or `fine`.

all_of: REPLACE: the behaviour that works today and must keep working
REPLACE: a second aspect of that same working behaviour
REPLACE: the shape or ordering the body already gets right
REPLACE: a fourth thing whose loss would be a regression nobody asked for
